courses.overview: 從換流站多時間尺度、能量失衡與保護協調延伸至相近領域；相似物理不代表同一設備規格或驗收程序。
courses.overviewEn: Extend converter-station timescales, energy imbalance and protection coordination to neighboring domains; shared physics does not imply identical equipment requirements or acceptance procedures.

related.title: 模組化多階換流器
related.why: MMC 子模組能量構成站級能量
related.whyEn: MMC submodule energy builds station-level energy
related.transfer: MMC 子模組能量構成站級能量
related.transferEn: MMC submodule energy builds station-level energy
related.difference: 站級包含電網與保護邊界
related.differenceEn: Station studies include grid and protection boundaries
practice: 以「短路比邊界」為起點，畫出本課與「模組化多階換流器」可共用及須重畫的系統邊界。
針對「站級包含電網與保護邊界」各選一項能區分兩課的量測。
將本課算例移植到新情境：保留方程依據，重新指定單位、材料或拓撲，並標示無法沿用的數值。
practiceEn: Start from short-circuit ratio and mark shared/redefined boundaries with modular multilevel converters.
For the difference "Station studies include grid and protection boundaries", choose discriminating measurements for both courses.
Transfer the worked example: retain justified equations, respecify units, materials or topology and identify values that cannot transfer.
